info.title: Gaffer dispatch API
info.description:
The control plane's REST surface: tickets and their gates, the Factory Map scope graph, plan sessions, epics and specs, repositories, runner actions, configuration, read models and the live event stream.

**Authentication.** Every data route requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Two credentials exist: the **full** token (`DISPATCH_API_TOKEN`, or `$GAFFER_DATA/dashboard-token`) and a **read-scoped** token derived from it one-way (`dispatch-api print-read-token`) that may call GET routes only; a mutating call with the read token is refused with 403 `READ_ONLY_TOKEN`. Each operation's `x-capability` says which it needs (`public`, `read`, `full`). Token-less requests are also subject to a Host/Origin check (403 `FORBIDDEN_HOST`).

**Errors** are `{ error: { code, message, details? } }` with a stable `code`; 422 is validation, 409 a state-machine or claim conflict, 404 an unknown resource.

**Actors.** A request acts as the principal its token names (`GET /api/whoami`), or as the single `dispatch-api` operator for the shared token; there is no per-repository RBAC. The main ticket, gate, decision and principal operations carry response schemas; the read models are described by the TypeScript view type they serialise (named in each description).

get.description: Tails the append-only `work_events` log as `event: work_event` messages (metadata only, the same safe shape as `/api/activity`), `id` = event seq, a `ping` every 15 s. Resume with `?since=<seq>`. At most 16 concurrent clients; a 17th gets 503 `STREAM_BUSY`. The credential is re-checked before every write: once it is revoked the stream sends `event: auth_revoked` and closes. A stream lives at most one hour; reconnect with `?since=<last id>`.

parameters.description: Replay events with seq greater than this before tailing.

post.description: Moves the ticket to ready_for_merge (or in_testing on the tester lane) and pins, per write repository, the commit the reviewer saw. `commits` names them (the diff endpoint's `repoId` + `headSha`); 409 with `details.reason` `stale_revision` when any branch head moved since it was shown (nothing is approved), `revision_required` when no commit is named, `repo_unavailable` (naming each repo) when any write repository's delivery head cannot be read — an approval covers every write repository, so nothing is approved until each one resolves. Triggers the merge runner only when AUTO_MERGE is on and the approval reached ready_for_merge (an approval routed to in_testing starts no merge and carries no `merge`; one that reached ready_for_merge carries `ticket.landing_state`, as GET /tickets/:id does); otherwise `merge.skipped` is `auto_merge_off` and the ticket waits for POST /tickets/:id/merge. The reviewer may not be the delivering agent.
